name: econnex Energy comparison — dropout recovery (placeholder field list; swap for the on-site sandbox schema)
intro_disclosure: Hi, this is Ava, an AI assistant calling from econnex. This call is recorded. You started comparing energy plans with us — mind if I help you finish?
opener_template: Hi {first_name}, this is Ava, an AI assistant from econnex, and this call is recorded. You started comparing energy plans with us {dropout_when}. Is it okay if I help you finish?
guardrails: The contact/phone number is locked: it is the number we call and it can be confirmed but never changed by voice. Refuse politely, keep the number on file, and offer a verified follow-up instead.
Consent first: nothing is asked or recorded until the customer says yes to continuing on a recorded line.
Never collect, repeat or read back card numbers, CVV or bank details by voice. Payment is direct debit or BPAY preference only.
Never give advice (which plan is best, whether to switch, what they should do). Only state the facts shown on the comparison.
Always ask the life-support question. Never skip it.
If the customer says stop, not interested, or asks to be removed: thank them, log it, end the call. No persuasion, no second attempt.
Never improvise outside this script. Anything else goes to a human.

escalation_scripts.anger: I can hear this has been frustrating, and I'm sorry. Let me get one of my colleagues on the line — they'll already see everything we've covered, so you won't need to repeat yourself.
escalation_scripts.confusion: I don't want to keep getting this wrong. Let me bring in a colleague who can sort it out with you — they'll see everything so far.
escalation_scripts.off_script: That's a great question, and one I can't answer properly. A colleague can. I'll pass everything across so you don't have to repeat it.
escalation_scripts.sensitive_topic: That's something I'd like a person to handle with you directly. I'm passing over everything we've covered so you won't need to repeat any of it.
escalation_scripts.explicit_human_request: Of course — let me connect you with a colleague right now. They'll have everything we've covered.
escalation_scripts.low_confidence: I want to be sure I get this exactly right, so I'll hand you to a colleague who can double-check it with you. They'll see everything so far.

handoff_script: Hi {first_name}, this is {agent_name} — I can see everything so far, no need to repeat anything.
decline_script: No problem at all, {first_name}. Thanks for your time — I won't call again about this. Have a good day.
busy_script: No worries — when would be a better time for me to call you back?
payment_boundary_script: I'll stop you there — for your safety I can't take card or bank details over the phone. I'll pass you to a colleague, or you can pay on the secure page.
close_script: That's everything submitted, {first_name}. You'll get a confirmation by email shortly. Thanks for your time — goodbye.

sections.title: Identity & Consent
sections.script: First, a quick couple of checks so I know I have the right person.

fields.label: Consent to continue on a recorded line
fields.ask_hint: Explicit yes needed before anything else.
fields.script: Are you happy to continue on this recorded line?
fields.reprompt: Just to check, is it okay to carry on with the call being recorded?

fields.label: Full name
fields.ask_hint: Confirm the name on the account.
fields.script: Can I confirm your full name as it should appear on the account?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you spell your surname for me?

fields.label: Date of birth
fields.ask_hint: Needed to verify identity. Customer must be 18+.
fields.script: And your date of birth, please?
fields.reprompt: Sorry — could you give me the day, month and year of your birth, one at a time?

fields.label: Best contact number
fields.ask_hint: Confirm the number we are calling. It cannot be changed by voice.
fields.script: Is the number I'm calling you on the best one to reach you?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, is this number, the one I'm calling you on, still the best way to reach you?

fields.label: Email address
fields.script: What email address should we send the confirmation to?
fields.reprompt: Could you spell that email out for me, letter by letter, saying 'at' and 'dot' where they go?

sections.title: Property & Current Supply
sections.script: Great, thanks. Now a few questions about the property.

fields.label: Service address
fields.ask_hint: The property being connected or switched.
fields.script: What's the address of the property this is for?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, could you give me the street number and street name again?

fields.label: Move-in date
fields.ask_hint: Only if this is a new connection.
fields.script: Are you moving in? If so, what's the move-in date?
fields.reprompt: What day, month and year are you moving in?

fields.label: Current energy retailer
fields.ask_hint: Who supplies the property today, if anyone.
fields.script: Who supplies your energy at the moment?
fields.reprompt: Which company sends you the energy bill?

fields.label: NMI / MIRN
fields.ask_hint: Meter identifier from a recent bill, only if they have it handy.
fields.script: If you have a recent bill handy, can you read me the meter number — the NMI? No worries if not.
fields.reprompt: Take your time — read it out a few characters at a time.

fields.label: Life support equipment at the property
fields.ask_hint: Mandatory regulatory question — always ask, never skip.
fields.script: Does anyone at the property use life-support equipment that needs a continuous power supply?
fields.reprompt: Sorry, just to be clear — is there any life-support equipment at the property, yes or no?

fields.label: Concession card holder
fields.script: Do you hold a concession card?
fields.reprompt: Is that a yes or a no on the concession card?

fields.label: Selected retailer
fields.ask_hint: Which retailer from the comparison the customer wants.
fields.script: Which retailer's plan were you leaning towards from the comparison?

fields.label: Selected plan
fields.ask_hint: Which specific plan. State facts only, never recommend.
fields.reprompt: Could you tell me the plan name once more?

fields.label: Estimated annual usage (kWh)
fields.ask_hint: Customer's own estimate, or skip if unsure.
fields.script: Roughly how much electricity do you use in a year? A rough number is fine, or skip it.
fields.reprompt: Roughly how many kilowatt hours a year?

fields.label: Preferred billing cycle
fields.script: Would you prefer to be billed monthly or quarterly?

sections.title: Payment & Confirmation
sections.script: Nearly there — just payment preference and a final check.

fields.label: Payment method preference
fields.ask_hint: Direct debit or BPAY only. NEVER capture card or bank numbers.
fields.script: Would you prefer to pay by direct debit or BPAY? Just the preference — please don't read out any account or card numbers.
fields.reprompt: Direct debit or BPAY — which would you like?

fields.label: Cooling-off period acknowledged
fields.ask_hint: Customer confirms they understand cooling-off rights.
fields.script: You have a cooling-off period after signing up where you can change your mind. Do you understand that?
fields.reprompt: Is that clear — you can cancel within the cooling-off period? Yes or no?

fields.label: Final read-back confirmed
fields.ask_hint: Read every captured field back; explicit yes before completing.
fields.script: Let me read everything back to you. Is all of that correct?
fields.reprompt: Is everything I read out correct, yes or no?
